name: owner_candle_sweep_15_ema50_nyam_1tr_same

source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-17: 15-minute previous-candle sweep, close back inside its body, stop at the candle extreme, 1:0.5; with the 1-hour EMA 50 (long above, short below); at most 1 trade a day (owner, 2026-10-18); both candles the trade's colour (owner, 2026-10-18)

entry.words: On 15-minute bars look at the previous candle. If this candle sweeps the previous candle's low and closes back higher, inside its body, go long at the close; if it sweeps the previous candle's high and closes back lower, inside its body, go short. Stop at the candle's extreme, target half the risk (1 : 0.5). Only long when price is above the 1-hour EMA 50, only short when it is below. Both the previous candle and the sweeping candle must be green for a long, both red for a short.

taught: [chat 2026-10-17] we look at the previous candle: if we sweep a high or low, then close back inside within it, we enter
[chat 2026-10-17] sweep the previous candle's low, reverse and close higher within the body = long; vice versa = short
[chat 2026-10-17] stop at the candle extreme and 1:0.5
[chat 2026-10-17] now add a 1 hour ema and only long above and short below (length 50, the owner's pick)
[chat 2026-10-18] test and show me the metrics for 1 trade a day and compare with no limit
[chat 2026-10-18] now try it must be green green candle or red red candle
not_run: THE BODY: 'close higher within the body' is read as a close above the bottom of the previous candle's body (a long); a close past its top counts too.

THE COLOURS: read as green-green = long and red-red = short (the sweeping candle the trade's colour, as in the opposite-colour test before it); green = close above open, red = close below; a doji is neither.

THE 1-HOUR EMA: EMA(50) of the 1-hour closes (the last print of each whole ET hour that has ended; empty hours make none), carried across days back to 150 closes, the contract's first day or 30 sessions; seeded with the oldest close. The signal bar's close must be strictly above it (long) or below it (short); with fewer than 50 closes (the days right after a contract roll) there is no trade.

THE STOP: the sweeping candle's extreme, measured from its close and placed from the fill at the next bar's open; floored at 0.25 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars, as every structure stop of the engine.
A SWEEP OF BOTH SIDES that closes back inside the body is no trade.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held overnight.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
THE CAP: 1 trade a day (the first signal of NY morning that passes the EMA side); one session pass, so it is the day's cap.
